events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who died six days after being shot in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: More than two decades on, Tupac Shakur's music and powerful lyrics continue to resonate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with a guitar. His influence is still felt today. Which Hendrix track is essential listening for you?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to 'Here Comes the Sun', it's pure genius. What's your top track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating Chrissie Hynde, the distinctive lead vocalist and songwriter of The Pretenders, on her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style with The Pretenders are truly iconic. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the iconic Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher is 54 today! His swagger and voice defined an era. What's your go-to Liam tune?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal 'Imagine' album, with its powerful message of peace, was released in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. Its message is as relevant today as it was then. What does this album mean to you?

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod in 2001, completely revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got an iPod? 25 years since it changed the game for digital music. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and which theme tune gets you in the mood for espionage?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of comedy legend and Monty Python star, John Cleese, as he turns 87.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, universally known as the 'White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Classic
angles.copy: 58 years of the 'White Album'! The Beatles truly pushed boundaries with this one. Which of its diverse tracks is your hidden gem?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: A True Showman
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the extraordinary Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul' album in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution.

angles.name: Evolution of Sound
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! This album was a game-changer for The Beatles. Which track from it still sounds fresh today?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980, a day that shook the music world.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. What's his lasting impact on you?
